title: dendrobium lithocola
intro: Dendrobium lithocola, commonly known as the "Dendrobium orchid," is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the genus Dendrobium. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the relief of fever, cough, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dendrobium lithocola include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
